title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: Voided and Accomplished Documents
content:
Two statuses close the life of a document in the `Bills of Lading and Transport Documents` range: voided, when the document is cancelled, and accomplished, when the cargo it covers has been delivered. This page says which documents can reach each status and what may still be recorded afterwards.

## Clauses

1. **Unissued documents.** A document in draft or approved status is voided when the booking it covers is cancelled, or when the documentation party withdraws its shipping instructions. A document that never reached issue attracts no fee.
2. **Surrendered documents.** A document in the status surrendered is voided in one situation only: when a switch bill takes its place.
3. **Issued documents.** The desk never voids an issued document. If originals of an issued document are lost, the answer is a replacement set within the same document, not voiding.
4. **Accomplishment.** When delivery of the cargo under a released document is completed, the system marks the document accomplished. From then on, the only thing that may still be recorded against it is payment of fees that were booked earlier.

## Status overview

| Status of the document | Can it be voided? | Ground |
|---|---|---|
| Draft | Yes | Booking cancelled, or shipping instructions withdrawn |
| Approved | Yes | Booking cancelled, or shipping instructions withdrawn |
| Issued | No | Lost originals are met by a replacement set instead |
| Surrendered | Yes, in one case | Replaced by a switch bill |
| Released | Not covered by voiding | Proceeds to accomplished when delivery completes |
| Accomplished | Not covered by voiding | Closed except for payments of fees already booked |

## Basis Q&A

**The booking behind an approved draft has been cancelled. Is there a charge for the document?** No. It is voided, and a document never issued carries no fee.

**A customer asks the desk to void an issued negotiable bill because an original has gone astray. Is that possible?** No. An issued document is not voided; the loss is handled by a replacement set on the same document where the type allows reissue.

**May a correction fee be added to an accomplished document?** No. Only payments of fees that were already booked can still be recorded on it.
